boundaries.name: district discounts make each project affordable and determine the actual payment
a combined Build applies the district discount once and the faction discount only to its Facility
an exchange is legal before a blocked action and does not falsely promise to enable it
an exchange may leave a previously affordable Build blocked, while fixed-rate and cap limits remain enforced
The Dead Remain on Shift pays excess Scrutiny before its Facility produces
overflow exhausts Runway, then Trust, without a pending settlement
both Research paths settle Benchmark Leak before deciding whether Scientific Method is affordable
a later Human Evaluation cannot retroactively fund a penalty or earn a transient Trust award
a Venture survives relocation as a contract but produces only between adjacent districts
Era summaries move with project unlock data and do not mutate authored inputs
compiled instructions agree with project unlocks, shared risk, and Fusion connections
Deploy honors Compute Estate and Human Access discounts, handles caps, and matches browser execution
Fund accounting credits gross runway once, handles Scrutiny overflow penalties separately, and records credited income accurately
Fusion immediately connects nearby Facilities upon construction, and Quantum produces Capability before Era IV AGI recognition
